column1: # Sky events (research round 17, addendum; First hours and Terrain, 11-05): the meteorite (a cube; its hot glow _e made in code from the crust's cracks), impact glass lining a crater's bowl, and suevite (broken impact rock) for its rim. BLOCK_LIKE: obsidian,stone,gravel,cobblestone

column3: meteorite|cube|A meteorite's surface as a block, seamless: a thin black fusion crust (#141416 #1e1e22 #2a2a30) over dark iron-grey stony iron (#3a3c40 #4c4e54 #62646a), the crust broken by a few fine branching cracks showing dark grey beneath, shallow thumbprint hollows (regmaglypts) 4-7 px across lightly shaded, a few small rust-brown stains (#5a3a26 #74482a) and three or four tiny bright metallic glints (#a8acb4 #c8ccd4) of nickel-iron, light from the top left
column4: impact_glass|cube|Impact glass lining a meteor crater, seamless: dark smoky green-black natural glass (#16201a #22302a #30443a #46604e) in smooth glossy flowing swirls and ropy folds like solidified melt, a few small pale bubbles, one or two soft lighter green-grey streaks where the light catches, opaque, light from the top left
column5: suevite|cube|Suevite, a broken impact rock, seamless: angular broken fragments 3-8 px of grey stone (#5a5e5c #747876 #8e9290), a few darker basalt bits (#3a3c3e) and small black-green glass shards (#22302a #3a4a40) set in a fine dusty pale grey-brown matrix (#7a746a #8c8578), sharp edges, no rounded pebbles, light from the top left
